facts.fact: TCRA's Director General said the Tanzania Bureau of Standards (TBS) has newly introduced a Tanzania Standard on accessibility of communications and ICT products and services for persons with disabilities; the document gives no standard number or issue date (published 2026-10-09, used as the date).

note: No certification fact: TBS 'recognised' TCRA's website for implementing the accessibility standard, which is recognition, not certification, and no certifier or certificate is named.
